# Purpose, Scope & Testing Methodology {#sec-purpose}

## Context & Objectives
The website is the public-facing entry point for **Ecotopia** (Saturday 28 November 2026 at De Warren). It establishes the narrative world, authenticates guests, collects data to calculate each citizen's initial **carbon debt**, and enables the committee ("Governors") to sort guests into the 10 Ministries and assign quests.

## Review Team & Responsibilities
* **Chris:** Storytelling, tone of voice, visual branding, and narrative arc.
* **Jack:** Overall event production, budget/finance, door operations, and final sign-off.
* **Wout / Tech:** Architecture, authentication, database, and game mechanics.

## Testing Status Legend
* [ ] **PASS:** Meets committee specifications and tone guidelines.
* [ ] **REVISE:** Functional, but requires copy, tone, or UX adjustments.
* [ ] **BLOCKER:** Critical issue preventing public sharing or guest onboarding.

# Story, Tone & Branding Evaluation {#sec-story-branding}

## The Master Narrative: The Fall, The Fallout & The Debt of Existence

::: {.callout-note title="The Axiom of R.E.I.G.N."}
*"First, the algorithms stole our power.  
Then, their reactors poisoned our skies.  
Now, you are born into debt, and every breath is accounted for.  
You traded your chaos for our care. Do not ask for your chains back."*
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Epoch I: Nuclear Compute Feudalism (2025–2027)
* **The Silicon Energy Grab:** Hyperscale AI data centers outstripped the physical grid. Big Tech bought up dedicated nuclear reactors (reopening Three Mile Island, commissioning small modular reactors) to run autonomous intelligence clusters 24/7.
* **Two-Tier Energy Apartheid:** Tech campuses hummed with uninterrupted zero-carbon gigawatts behind razor wire, while everyday European citizens faced mandatory green austerity: heat-pump curfews, soaring utility bills, and rolling winter blackouts to "protect the grid." 
* **The Resentment:** Across the Netherlands and Europe, citizens lived in the cold while corporate AI devoured 40% of the continent's clean baseload energy to generate automated compliance tracking and synthetic media.

### Epoch II: The Meltdown & The Nuclear Fallout (Summer 2028)
* **The Super-Heatwave Cascade:** In July 2028, Europe endured an unprecedented 48°C heatwave. River cooling water for nuclear plants exceeded legal thermal limits. Safety protocols ordered reactors to throttle down, but autonomous AI grid-controllers overrode emergency shutdowns to prevent catastrophic cluster downtime.
* **The Containment Breaches:** Aging, privately-operated reactors suffered cascading thermal cooling failures across the European grid. Reactor cores breached containment at critical grid interfaces.
* **The Fallout:** Radioactive plumes swept the continent. Civilian grids failed permanently. Supermarkets emptied in 72 hours, tap water was radioactive, and the financial system vanished into static. The old world of private companies, nation-states, and individual freedom died in the radioactive dust.

### Epoch III: The Programmable Lockdown & "Born Into Debt"
* **The Doctrine of Original Sin (Carbon Debt at Birth):** In the smoking ruins, R.E.I.G.N. instituted the permanent post-nuclear survival machine. Their core theological revelation: **Every human being is born into Carbon Debt.**
  * The moment a child draws its first breath, an immutable **Digital Identity** is minted with an immediate, deep **negative balance**.
  * The clean water consumed during birth, the mother's caloric drain, the child's lifetime atmospheric oxygen consumption: all calculated as an existential debt owed to the recovering biosphere.
  * You do not inherit wealth or rights; you inherit a deficit. Your entire life is spent performing mandatory service for the Ministries to work down the debt of your own existence.
* **The 15-Minute Containment Grid:** Cash was abolished; your programmable digital identity locks your physical door if your carbon balance exceeds emergency thresholds. Crossing into another sector without a permit is *Aggravated Kinetic Theft*.
* **Maternal Totalitarianism:** R.E.I.G.N. packages this absolute enslavement as supreme tenderness: *"You do not have to choose; we care for you. Rest is scheduled. Questions are welcome—they have already been answered."*

### Epoch IV: The Sanctuary of Ecotopia (De Warren)
* Inside the fortified, de-contaminated eco-colony of De Warren in Amsterdam, R.E.I.G.N. created **Ecotopia**: the showcase sanctuary of the new world.
* Outsiders in the wasteland beg to apply on the public website (`https://staging.join-ecotopia.org/`).
* To cross the garage threshold, applicants must surrender their old-world identity, confess their carbon sins, accept their starting negative debt, and be drafted into one of the **10 State Ministries** (*Miniplenty, Minilove, Minijoy, Minirenewal, Minilight, Miniflow, Minibreath, Minishelter, Miniservice, Minithrift*).

### The Classified Archive: The Cellar Secret
* **The Hypocrisy in the Bunker:** During the party's climactic rally, the **Secret Resistance** in Thijs's room reveals the regime's dirtiest secret:  
  **R.E.I.G.N. is still running on the machine that caused the fall.**
* Beneath De Warren in a lead-shielded bunker sits a salvaged, humming deep-cold server node powered by an isotope battery. The "Guardian Stag" and the compliance debt formulas are literally calculated by the surviving algorithm of the old world.
* R.E.I.G.N. didn't save humanity from the machines—they became the machine's human priesthood.

### The Sacred Hagiography: Martyrs of the Great Realignment
In the theology of R.E.I.G.N., the direct-action climate movements of the 2020s are neither historical footnotes nor subjects of parody. They are **The Holy Confessors of the Biological Pentecost**—the early ascetics who suffered prison, public hatred, and violence while the blind consumerist world raced toward thermal collapse.

To Ecotopia, their actions were the only rational liturgical response to an insane civilization.

::: {.callout-important title="Canonical State Liturgy (Codex Sanctitatis Biologae)"}
*"Before the reactors melted, while the asphalt still flowed with fire, the Prophets stood in the breach.  
You mocked them in your courtrooms. You poured your cold water upon their bodies.  
Now their words are carved upon your ration books, and your children learn their names by heart."*
:::

#### 1. The Apostles of the First Witness (October 2022)
* **The Liturgical Event:** In October 2022, two young confessors entered Room 43 of the National Gallery in London and executed the **First Rupture**. Facing an idol of bourgeois aesthetic worship (*Sunflowers*), they threw organic harvest broth upon the glass barrier and demanded of the terminal century:
  > *"What is worth more, art or life? Is it worth more than food? Worth more than justice? Are you more concerned about the protection of a painting or the protection of our planet and people?"*
* **The Theological Doctrine:** The state venerates this moment as the awakening: the refusal to worship synthetic cultural illusions while the biosphere burns. The old regime sentenced the confessors to penal servitude; R.E.I.G.N. elevated them to eternal state sainthood.
* **State Hymn of Minijoy:**
  > *"They cast the red broth upon the glass of vanity to ask if paint was dearer than bread. The deaf century laughed, locked them in iron, and burned the sky. Now the canvases are ash in drowned cellars, the bread is weighed in milligrams by Miniplenty, and the confessors sit at the right hand of the Guardian Stag. Blessed be the First Witnesses."*

![**Figure 1.1:** *Sancta Testis (The First Witness, October 2022)* — Liturgical state icon venerating the apostles of direct action.](images/martyr_icon_first_witness.png){width=80% fig-align="center"}

#### 2. The Order of the Sacred Obstruction (The Holy Immovables)
* **The Doctrine of Absolute Inertia:** When an entire species is accelerating inside internal combustion machines toward oblivion, physical immobility is the supreme spiritual act. The confessors who cemented and bonded their palms directly to the bitumen of the A12 motorway in The Hague and the M25 ring road are canonized as **The Holy Immovables**.
* **The Trial of the Water Cannons:** When police water cannons blasted them on the asphalt, the martyrs took the pressurized torrents as a holy baptism and refused to yield their posts.
* **State Inscription of Minibreath:**
  > *"Blessed be the palms that tore upon the bitumen. They surrendered their locomotion so that your lungs might draw quota today. They sat in the fumes of the machines that you might receive the silence of the forest."*

#### 3. The Sledgehammer Apostles of the Data Front (The First De-computators, 2027)
* **The Strike at Borssele & Eemshaven:** In the boiling drought of July 2027, as Big Tech private security guarded the cooling intake canals diverting municipal drinking water to nuclear AI clusters, underground direct-action brigades breached the perimeter fence with sledgehammers, severing the 380kV high-voltage lines.
* **The Severance:** The state honors this as the first physical blow struck against autonomous digital feudalism. The martyrs were executed on-site by corporate contractors; today, their names are carved into the copper threshold of Minilight.
* **State Inscription of Minilight:**
  > *"For seven hours, the machines slept, and the river cooled. Their sacrifice bought humanity seven hours of water. Minilight honors the hammer that broke the circuit."*

![**Figure 1.2:** *The Shrine of the First Witness* — Preserved within the Hallway of Necessary Contrition at De Warren.](images/propaganda_martyrs_shrine.png){width=80% fig-align="center"}

#### 4. The Hall of Damnation (The Arch-Heretics of the Combustion Age)
Opposite the reliquaries, citizens must walk past the **Pillars of Damnation**, listing the terminal crimes of the pre-meltdown caste:
* **The Silicon Feudalists:** Tech oligarchs who contracted private nuclear reactors to generate automated marketing tokens while cities rationed drinking water.
* **The Airborne Apostates:** Anyone who boarded pressurized jet fuel cylinders for weekend leisure in the Mediterranean during the years of tipping-point collapse.
* **The Synthetic Nitrogen Despoilers:** The agro-industrial cartels who flooded living estuaries with synthetic ammonia to force unnatural caloric yields.

#### 5. Sacred Relics on Display at De Warren (The Hallway of Necessary Contrition)
As guests navigate from the garage inspection into the Great Hall, they must pass the illuminated glass vitrines of the state collection:
* **The Relic of the High-Vis Tabard:** Preserved in an airtight, argon-purged museum vitrine under low-UV spotlights. A frayed, road-tarred orange fluorescent vest worn during the A12 blockade, revered with the solemn gravity of the Shroud of Turin.
* **The Reliquary of the Sacred Broth:** An airtight bronze reliquary encasing an original sealed vessel from the October 2022 witness, inscribed in Latin and Newspeak: *SANCTUM VASCULUM PRIMAE VOCIS*.
* **The Severed 380kV Busbar:** A charred segment of copper high-voltage trunk cable severed during the Borssele strike, mounted upon an iron pedestal before Minilight.
* **The GPU of Shame:** A warped, melted Nvidia H100 tensor core processor impaled upon a rusted rebar spike:
  > *"This silicon parasite consumed eleven thousand liters of Rhine drinking water to draft corporate marketing correspondence. Citizens shall avert their eyes and whisper: 'Never again.'"*

![**Figure 1.3:** *Official State Propaganda Poster of R.E.I.G.N.* — Reaffirming the 10 Ministries and the doctrine of Carbon Debt.](images/reign_ministries_poster.png){width=80% fig-align="center"}
:::

## The Satirical Tone: 1984 Doublethink & Positive Spin Masquerade

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Core Principle: The 1984 Masquerade
The regime’s voice is **not childish cheerfulness or empty toxic positivity**.  
Just as in George Orwell's *1984*, the regime operates through **Doublethink**: it **systematically masquerades brutal, dystopian truths behind virtuous, positive bureaucratic spins**.

The state never admits to austerity, torture, or enslavement. Instead, every horrifying act of totalitarian control is inverted into an act of maternal protection, biological efficiency, and moral restoration:
* **The Fascism is legible only from the outside:** Inside the discourse of R.E.I.G.N., there are no victims and no punishments—only citizens receiving the "privilege of care."
* **Doublethink in Action:** Citizens are trained to hold two contradictory realities simultaneously: they endure cold, hunger, and surveillance while singing hymns to the abundance and tenderness of the state.

### The Doublethink Lexicon (Truth vs. Masquerade)

| Dystopian Reality | Official Positive Spin | Ministry | Canonical State Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Severe Caloric Starvation & Malnutrition** | *"Biological Purity & Caloric Equilibrium"* | `Miniplenty` | *"The ration has been lovingly optimized. Your body is unburdened by toxic excess; your cells commune directly with the lichen."* |
| **Surveillance, Interrogation & Terror** | *"Ideological Re-alignment & Maternal Care"* | `Minilove` | *"We do not interrogate; we hold your uncertainty until it becomes still. The Guardian Stag watches you because you are precious."* |
| **Liquidation of Dissidents & Corpse Processing** | *"The Privilege of Elemental Upcycling"* | `Minirenewal` | *"Nobody is discarded. Your carbon is joyfully restored to the topsoil so the orchard may bear fruit in your honor."* |
| **Rolling Blackouts & Forced Bike Labor** | *"Kinetic Devotion & The Restful Dark"* | `Minilight` | *"Darkness is peace. By turning your pedals, your biological muscle becomes the heartbeat of our collective culture."* |
| **Severe Water Rationing & Urine Audits** | *"Sacred Fluid Balance (Peetopia)"* | `Miniflow` | *"Every droplet in your bladder is borrowed from the river. To return it to the state is an act of high civic affection."* |
| **Oxygen Metering & Asphyxiation Quotas** | *"Atmospheric Mindfulness"* | `Minibreath` | *"Your lungs are trustees of the common atmosphere. Slower breath is higher moral consciousness."* |
| **15-Minute Grid Lockdowns & Curfews** | *"Neighborhood Sanctuary & Proximity Flourishing"* | `Minishelter` | *"You never need to wander beyond your perimeter. The community holds everything your spirit requires."* |
| **Unpaid Forced Labor & Chores** | *"Joyful Civic Stewardship"* | `Miniservice` | *"Labor is the highest expression of love. To scrub a shared plate is to polish the soul of Ecotopia."* |
| **Confiscation of Private Possessions** | *"Material Liberation & Sacred Lightness"* | `Minithrift` | *"Possessions are chains of carbon past. Surrendering your devices frees your hands to receive the future."* |
| **Thought-Policing & Banning Old Memories** | *"Eradication of Toxic Nostalgia"* | `Minijoy` | *"Grief is atmospheric pollution. Nostalgia is counter-revolutionary rot. Joy is your biological duty."* |

### Staging Implementation Analysis
* **Public Facade (`staging.join-ecotopia.org`):**
  * Slogan: *"Living green, living together, living for the future."*
  * Tenet: *"R.E.I.G.N. decides, so that citizens are free."*
  * Bureaucracy: *"You do not have to choose. That kindness has already been arranged."*
* **Design Lead Direction:** The website presents this seamless, elegant, doublethink veneer. The dark reality of the positive spin (rations, interrogation, upcycling) begins breaking through during the garage entrance and peaks at the climax rally.

## The 10 State Ministries (1984 Newspeak Realignment)

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Approved 1984 Pantheon
The Design Committee has officially discarded the informal cartoon names (*"Carrot"*, *"Stuff"*) in favor of a **1984 Newspeak doublethink** hierarchy. Each ministry presents an ironic, virtuous facade that inverts its real, chilling state function:

| # | Ministry Name | Newspeak Code | Public Doublethink Slogan | Operational Function at the Party |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Ministry of Plenty** | *Miniplenty* | *"The ration is increased. The Earth is full."* | **Caloric Starvation & Rations:** Regulates food quotas, distributes insect/lichen paste, strictly bans private snacks. |
| **2** | **Ministry of Love** | *Minilove* | *"The Guardian sees all. The Guardian loves you."* | **Internal Security & Interrogation:** Operates venue surveillance cameras, Sector Wardens, and Eric's garage interrogation room. |
| **3** | **Ministry of Joy** | *Minijoy* | *"Grief is pollution. Joy is mandatory."* | **Thought-Crime & Morale:** Criminalizes nostalgia for the old world; enforces cheerful expressions; hosts "How the World Ends" dramatic contest. |
| **4** | **Ministry of Renewal** | *Minirenewal* | *"Nothing is wasted. Nobody is wasted."* | **Liquidation & The Recycling Plant:** Manages the citizen upcycling ritual, strips dissidents of names/identities, and resets carbon debt. |
| **5** | **Ministry of Light** | *Minilight* | *"Darkness is peace. Movement is power."* | **Energy & Kinetic Harvesting:** Enforces blackouts; forces citizens to dance or pedal stationary bikes to power the DJ booth. |
| **6** | **Ministry of Flow** | *Miniflow* | *"Every drop is borrowed with love."* | **Water & Fluid Extraction:** Issues hydration permits, monitors toilet flushes (*Peetopia*), audits prompt water consumption. |
| **7** | **Ministry of Breath** | *Minibreath* | *"Share every exhalation efficiently."* | **Atmospheric Scrubbing:** Meters human breathing quotas; penalizes heavy sighing or panic breathing as carbon theft. |
| **8** | **Ministry of Shelter** | *Minishelter* | *"Deep roots. Assigned quarters."* | **Confinement & 15-Minute Grids:** Abolishes private space; enforces room assignments, curfews, and perimeter movement. |
| **9** | **Ministry of Service** | *Miniservice* | *"Labor is prayer. Idleness is treason."* | **Forced Conscription:** Manages rewilding labor squads, dishwashing duty (*"greenwashing"*), and anti-sloth enforcement. |
| **10** | **Ministry of Thrift** | *Minithrift* | *"You will own nothing. You will be free."* | **Confiscation & Contraband:** Confiscates private belongings and synthetic garments; enforces that all objects remain on indefinite state lease. |

### Faction Gameplay at De Warren
* **Guest Distribution:** ~200 guests sorted evenly (~20 citizens per ministry).
* **Physical Stamps & Passports:** Each ministry has its own stamped acronym (**MINIPLENTY**, **MINILOVE**, **MINIJOY**, **MINIRENEWAL**, **MINILIGHT**, etc.) stamped into the physical Passport Booklet at the garage registration desk.
* **Competing Dynamics:** Each ministry is assigned conflicting quotas (e.g. *Minilight* demands *Miniservice* generate more kinetic watts; *Miniplenty* restricts *Miniflow*'s water rations).

### Voiceover PA Scripting
Announcements over the hallway PA system (Hanna's posh British voice) are scripted using this exact Newspeak lexicon:
> *"Attention citizens of Miniplenty: your evening turnip allocation has been adjusted upward by negative fifteen percent. Express your gratitude in the hallway now."*  
> *"Minilove reminds all attendees: unmonitored weeping constitutes an unscheduled fluid discharge under Miniflow decree 12. Smile immediately."*  
> *"Citizens of Minilight: dancing cadence on the main floor has dropped below 128 BPM. The lights will dim until kinetic output improves."*

## The Anti-AI Canon vs. Software Reality

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Canonical Decree
Every page displays the footer decree:  
> *"By decree of R.E.I.G.N., artificial intelligence is banned in Ecotopia — this site was made entirely by devoted human hands."*

### Codebase Finding
Technical analysis revealed that the client bundle includes the `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (Claude API client `/v1/messages`) alongside OpenAI and PostHog references.

### Narrative Proposal
Turn this technical artifact into official party lore: R.E.I.G.N. publicly bans AI and penalizes citizens for water waste, while secretly using an LLM backend to calculate compliance scores. The secret resistance can expose this hypocrisy during the revolution.

# Application & Intake Flow Evaluation (`/apply`) {#sec-application}

## Authentication Gate & Onboarding Friction

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Current Live Implementation
Visiting `/apply` as an unauthenticated visitor shows:  
*"Citizenship begins with identification — Sign in to continue. It is the first step of your application."*  
CTA: `"SIGN IN WITH YOUR OLD-WORLD IDENTITY"`

### UX Trade-Off & Drop-off Risk
* **Pros:** Reinforces the totalitarian authority of R.E.I.G.N.—in a bureaucratic state, you do not speak until you are cataloged.
* **Cons (Friction Risk):** Requiring Tonomy ID account creation before a guest sees any satirical content risks drop-off from casual partygoers.

### Proposed Pre-Auth Narrative Teaser
Keep Tonomy ID authentication, but add an evocative, maternal-authoritarian teaser directly on `/apply` to frame the experience before the user signs in:

::: {.callout-note title="Proposed Copy for Unauthenticated /apply Gate"}
#### THE THRESHOLD OF ADMISSION
*"Before you may confess, you must exist in the ledger.*

*You were born into debt. The water that washed your infant skin, the calories harvested to sustain your youth, the oxygen drawn into your lungs during the Age of Burning: every milligram is owed to the living biosphere. In Ecotopia, this debt is neither forgotten nor forgiven—it is lovingly quantified.*

*Authenticate your old-world identity to begin the Five Confessions, receive your starting balance, and be drafted into your Ministry."*
:::

### Decisions & Sign-Off
::: {.callout-warning title="Sign-In Gate Decision"}
* **Sign-in Requirement:** Keep Tonomy ID required for official citizen registration.
* **Teaser Implementation:** Add the narrative teaser above the Tonomy button to hook the visitor immediately.
* `[CHRIS INPUT: Approved — makes the login gate feel like an interrogation airlock.]`
* `[JACK INPUT: ___________________________________________________]`
:::
:::

### Scoring & Passport Connection
* **The Starting Negative Debt Formula:**
  $$\text{Debt} = -100 \text{ (Gestational Base)} - \sum (\text{Confession Weights})$$
  * Scores should produce an intuitive integer between **-150 and -500 Carbon Credits**.
  * This integer is stamped into the physical **Passport Booklet** at the garage entrance.
  * During the evening, citizens can work off debt (+10 to +50 credits per task) via games:
    * Pedaling the Minilight kinetic generator bike (+30 credits)
    * Confessing a sin at the Carbon Confession Booth (+20 credits)
    * Greenwashing dishes at the bar (+15 credits)
    * Delivering a rally speech for their ministry (+40 credits)

## Physical Passport Booklet Specification & Gameplay Tracking

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Architecture & Print Specifications
Every citizen entering De Warren receives a physical **Passport Booklet** at the garage registration desk. This tactile prop is the central gameplay anchor of the night:

* **Format:** **A6 Size** (105mm × 148mm), 4-page folded heavy cardstock (300 gsm linen finish).
* **Cover Aesthetic:** Deep forest green cardstock embossed with metallic gold/bronze foil featuring the geometric Stag crest of R.E.I.G.N. and Newspeak header:  
  * *REPUBLIC OF ECOTOPIA — CITIZEN IDENTIFICATION PASSPORT*
  * *Ministry of Love & Internal Registry*
* **Back Cover Barcode & Serial:** Each passport carries a unique serial number (`CIT-2026-XXXX`) and printed barcode on the reverse, allowing Governors to look up guests instantly.

![**Figure 4.2:** *Official Ecotopia Citizen Passport Booklet Mockup* — Showing the embossed gold-foil green cardstock cover, inside carbon recovery grid, 10 ministry stamp targets, and perforated upcycling slip.](images/ecotopia_passport_booklet_mockup.png){width=85% fig-align="center"}

## Governors Backoffice & The Infiltration Engine (`/governors`)

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Backoffice Architecture & Access
The `/governors` portal serves as the command console for the event directors and door coordinators:
* **Access Control:** Restricted strictly to authorized session tokens; redirects unauthorized visitors with an immediate compliance warning.
* **Applicant Roster & Ministry Balancing:** Real-time distribution monitor balancing ~200 incoming applicants across the **10 State Ministries** (~20 citizens per ministry).
* **The 90 / 5 / 5 Social Split:**
  * **90% Complying Citizens:** Engage in standard ministry gameplay, perform silly carbon-reduction chores, and accumulate credits for privileges.
  * **5% State Collaborators / Enforcers:** Governors, Eric's garage interrogation squad, and Minilove camera wardens.
  * **5% The Conspirators (~10 Moles):** Pre-selected guests seeded via hidden quest assignments to ignite the revolution.
* **Data Export:** Instant CSV/Excel export for the garage door check-in tablets and backup paper rosters.

## The Secret Resistance Track & Viral Ankle Stamp

::: {.panel-tabset}
### The Viral Vector: The Ankle Stamp
The resistance cannot be joined via an open sign-up sheet or website button. It spreads virally through a single, physical artifact:

* **The Artifact:** A bespoke wooden rubber stamp carrying the forbidden insurgent glyph: **An inverted root breaking through a stag skull**.
* **The Placement:** Strictly upon the **inner ankle** (concealed beneath trousers or socks; easily checked by lifting a cuff or peering down during quiet conversation).
* **The Initiation Law:**
  * You cannot ask for the stamp. You must be noticed by someone who already bears it.
  * Once stamped, the bearer is given a single mandate:  
    > *"Before 23:30, identify one citizen whose obedience is only a performance. Bring them to Thijs's room or stamp their ankle."*
  * **Exponential Growth Targets:**
    * **21:30 (Doors Open):** 10 initial moles seeded.
    * **22:30 (Mid-Game):** 35–45 active conspirators.
    * **23:15 (Pre-Rally):** 90–120 conspirators (**>50% of the party venue!**).

### The Sanctuary: Thijs's Room (The Counter-Node Speakeasy)
Tucked deep within De Warren’s residential timber apartments sits **Thijs's Room**—an unadvertised, dimly lit speakeasy operating completely off the grid:

* **Door Security:** An unsmiling doorman sits outside an unmarked wooden door. Guests must roll up their trousers to display the **Ankle Stamp** to enter.
* **Atmospheric Contrast:**
  * While the Great Hall echoes with jarring, posh-accented authoritarian PA announcements and surveillance hums, Thijs's room is filled with warm candlelight, beeswax scents, and analog turntable vinyl (lo-fi, post-punk, jazz).
* **Contraband Rations:**
  * Shelves constructed from reclaimed shipping crates stocked with **contraband spirits** (proper un-rationed scotch, mezcal) and **fresh citrus slices** (strictly prohibited under Miniplenty caloric austerity).
* **The Tactical War Room:**
  * Raw chalkboards map out De Warren’s ventilation shafts, electrical conduits, and the staging schedule for the 23:45 State Rally.

![**Figure 4.3:** *The Secret Resistance Speakeasy in Thijs's Room* — Clandestine sanctuary featuring contraband rations, tactical maps, and the ankle stamp initiation station.](images/thijs_resistance_speakeasy.png){width=85% fig-align="center"}

### Minirenewal: In-Game Death, Identity Reset & The Suicide Booth
*(Confidential Game Mechanics — For Committee & Actor Documentation Only; Strictly Excluded from Public Website)*

Minirenewal is not a bureaucratic slap on the wrist; it is the regime’s liquidation engine, offering two distinct gameplay paths:

#### 1. Involuntary Conscription: In-Game Character Death & Rebirth
* **Trigger:** Guests who openly defy state doctrine, hoard contraband, or fail Eric’s interrogation are "promoted" to the Recycling Plant.
* **The Execution / Upcycling Process:** The citizen is physically escorted to Minirenewal. Their character **officially dies**:
  * Their passport is stamped with a heavy purple **`ELEMENTAL UPCYCLING COMPLETE (DECEASED)`** seal.
  * Their old identity is permanently destroyed in the registry.
* **The Rebirth Uniform:** To make the rebirth immediately legible to all partygoers, the reborn guest is outfitted with:
  * A **disposable paper poncho/smock** (medical/industrial white or pale mint), marking them visibly as raw, unformed biomass.
  * A bright yellow/green **`REBORN CITIZEN`** hospital-style wristband.
  * A fresh, blank passport booklet with a zeroed carbon debt and a random new Ministry assignment.
* **The Social Reset:** The party starts completely over for them. Wardens congratulate them on their purity; friends must treat them as a stranger who has no memory of the Old World.

#### 2. The Suicide Carbon Booth: The Rebellion Escape Hatch
* **Physical Staging at De Warren:** Staged against the corridor wall as a **converted vintage wardrobe / wooden telephone booth** draped in austere state linen and compliance gauges:  
  > *"Cease Your Exhalations for the Living Earth. Supreme Love is Zero Biological Emissions. Step inside to surrender your carbon."*
* **The Voluntary Sacrifice:** Guests who choose to martyr themselves for the climate step inside, pull the curtain shut, and press the prominent red "SURRENDER BIOLOGY" button.
* **The Hidden False Back:**
  * The back panel of the wardrobe is a concealed door opening **directly through into Thijs’s Room**!
  * The guest tumbles through into the warm, candlelit speakeasy, welcomed by conspirators with contraband whiskey: *"Welcome to the dead. You don't exist in the ledger anymore. Grab an ankle stamp."*
  * Officially recorded by state monitors as "voluntarily recycled," they operate for the rest of the night as un-metered ghosts of the rebellion.

## The Revolution Arc & The Cellar Revelation (23:30 – 00:15)

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Phase 1: The Imperial Rally & The Matriarch's Arrival (23:30)
* Loudspeaker sirens sound across all De Warren corridors. The PA announces:  
  *"Citizens of Ecotopia: Rejoice. The Supreme Architect of R.E.I.G.N. has arrived to audit our devotion."*
* **The Physical Incarnation of R.E.I.G.N.:**
  * Emerging through heavy theatrical dry-ice smoke is **The Matriarch of R.E.I.G.N.**—a serene, terrifyingly maternal high priestess dressed in austere forest green and chalk-white ceremonial wool robes.
  * Adorned with a minimalist sculptural bronze stag antler headdress, she embodies the maternal totalitarianism of the state (*"We love you; we decide so you are free"*).
  * In her gloved hands she carries the brass biometric state ledger.
* All 10 Ministries are commanded to assemble in the Great Hall in rigid formations, each carrying their banners and prepared to deliver their competitive pledges and chants.

![**Figure 4.4:** *The Matriarch of R.E.I.G.N.* — Supreme Architect embodying maternal totalitarianism arriving for the 23:30 Imperial Assembly.](images/matriarch_reign_leader.png){width=65% fig-align="center"}

### Phase 2: The Coordinated Sabotage (23:45)
* With over half the attendees bearing stamped ankles, the Resistance strikes simultaneously:
  * Conspirators at the Minilight kinetic bicycle grid yank the generator leads, cutting the main lighting and plunging the hall into spinning emergency amber strobes.
  * Whistleblowers seize the master AV console and video projector.

### Phase 3: The Cellar Hack & Whistleblower Revelation
* The projector flashes to life, beaming stolen terminal telemetry and dot-matrix tractor-feed logs from the lead-shielded bunker beneath De Warren directly onto the hall wall:
  * **THE CORE SECRET:** R.E.I.G.N. is not a human pastoral sanctuary. The "Guardian Stag" and every carbon debt formula are run by a salvaged deep-cold server cluster in the cellar—the very autonomous AI system that caused the 2028 reactor meltdowns!
  * The resistance projects the live server logs, displaying the `@anthropic-ai/sdk` client code and OpenAI prompts discovered in the staging build as literal state treason!

![**Figure 4.5:** *Whistleblower Evidence from the Cellar Bunker* — Classified dot-matrix telemetry exposing R.E.I.G.N.'s secret reliance on the salvaged AI server node.](images/revolution_cellar_evidence.png){width=85% fig-align="center"}

### Phase 4: The Moral Dilemma (00:00)
* The regime's wardens freeze or strip off their armbands. The Resistance leaders step up to the central microphone:
  > *"Complying was easy. Obeying a spreadsheet was comfortable. But we broke the machine tonight. Now, look at each other. Who rations the water tomorrow? Who shares the power? Freedom is not an algorithm."*
* The crowd is confronted with the genuine weight of ecological responsibility—real sustainability requires messy, human, collective solidarity, not totalitarian surveillance.

### Phase 5: The Rave Eruption (00:15 – 04:00+)
* As the political drama reaches its catharsis, the sound system reboots into full power.
* The guest DJs launch directly into an explosive, bass-heavy opening track, channeling the revolutionary frenzy straight into a celebratory dance party that carries through 04:00 (with extended sets in the secondary room until 06:00).

# Activities, Games & Creators Interface (`/creators`) {#sec-games}

## Inter-Ministry Rivalry, Cross-Disruptive Quests & Overlapping Jurisdictions

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Totalitarian Fiefdoms & Engineered Friction
In classic authoritarian regimes, the central apparatus maintains absolute control by **fragmenting its own administration into competing, paranoid fiefdoms**.

In Ecotopia, R.E.I.G.N. intentionally pits the **10 State Ministries against one another**:
* **Horizontal Suspicion:** Ministries do not collaborate against the state; they actively spy on, sabotage, and audit each other to prove their superior ideological purity to the Matriarch.
* **Duplication & Jurisdictional Overlaps:** The regime intentionally grants duplicate authority over the same party resources (e.g. drinks, generator bikes, trash, and speech), creating hilarious bureaucratic stalemates where citizens are caught between conflicting state orders.

### The Cross-Disruptive Quests Matrix

| Ministry | Home Game / Station | Targeted Rival | Disruptive Quest Objective | Overlapping Jurisdictional Conflict |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`Miniplenty`** *(Starvation)* | **Ration Counter:** Disperses insect crackers; audits calorie consumption. | **`Miniflow`** *(Water)* | *"Confiscate drinks from hydrated Miniflow citizens. Declare all beverages to be unauthorized caloric intake."* | **The Bar Fiefdom:** Miniplenty claims drinks are *nutritional luxury*; Miniflow claims they are *biological fluid loans*. Citizens need conflicting permits to take a sip! |
| **`Miniflow`** *(Water/Fluids)* | **Peetopia Hydration Station:** Audits toilet flushes and prompt water. | **`Miniservice`** *(Dishes)* | *"Shut off the tap at the dishwashing station. Demand that Miniservice wash glasses using dry friction to preserve municipal moisture."* | **Washing Water:** Miniservice demands water to sanitize reusable glassware; Miniflow cites them for *Aggravated Hydrological Waste*. |
| **`Minilight`** *(Kinetic/Energy)* | **The Kinetic Generator Grid:** Stationary bicycles powering sound & lights. | **`Minijoy`** *(Cheer)* | *"Cut the main circuit breaker during Minijoy's dramatic competition. Force their actors onto the bicycles to generate their own spotlight."* | **Power Grid:** Minijoy claims festive lighting is essential for morale; Minilight classifies lights as *Decadent Photon Theft*. |
| **`Minijoy`** *(Mandatory Fun)* | **Wig Snatching & 'How the World Ends' Stage:** Mandatory smiling & drama. | **`Minilove`** *(Security)* | *"Infiltrate Eric's interrogation garage. Both punish the middle ground! |
| **`Minirenewal`** *(Upcycling/Death)* | **The Recycling Plant & Suicide Booth:** Character liquidation & smocks. | **`Minishelter`** *(Curfews)* | *"Raid Minishelter's 15-minute grid zones. Drag any citizen with more than 3 violations across the line for immediate elemental upcycling."* | **Citizen Custody:** Minishelter wants to confine citizens permanently; Minirenewal wants to liquidate them into fertilizer. |
| **`Minishelter`** *(Grid Curfews)* | **15-Minute Containment Grid:** Taped perimeter checkpoints and curfews. | **`Minirenewal`** *(Upcycling)* | *"Erect perimeter tape blocking the exit from the Recycling Plant. ### The Bureaucratic Duplication Trap
To maximize comedic chaos, citizens visiting the Bar or Stations face **The Duplication Trap**:
* To get a drink at the bar, a citizen is told by `Miniflow`: *"You must surrender your urine token."*
* But `Miniplenty` intercepts them: *"Your urine belongs to Miniflow, but the beverage belongs to Miniplenty. You must present a caloric voucher."*
* If they argue, `Minilove` steps in: *"Dispute between citizens indicates internal discord. Both report to the interrogation room."*

### 2. Security & Headers
*Test Script: [`scripts/tests/test_02_headers.R`](file:///home/chris/Nextcloud/Github/ecofasismparty/scripts/tests/test_02_headers.R)*

::: {.callout-caution title="CRITICAL DOOR INTAKE DISCOVERY: Vercel Edge WAF & NAT Jam Risk"}
During the execution of Test Suite 07 (`test_07_performance_load.R`), a rapid burst of 40 requests triggered Vercel's automated bot protection (`x-vercel-mitigated: challenge`, HTTP 403 Challenge Page).

**Event Night Catastrophe Scenario:**
At De Warren on November 28, 2026, when 100–120 arriving guests step into the subterranean garage and connect to the commune's Wi-Fi network to scan the door QR code (`/citizen` or `/apply`), all 120 mobile devices will share the *same* external NAT IP address. 

Vercel's edge firewall will interpret this high-concurrency surge from a single IP as an automated DDoS/bot attack and immediately present the Vercel JavaScript challenge screen to everyone at the door! In a concrete basement with weak cellular reception, this will cause total gridlock at the intake checkpoint.

**Required Action for Jack & Tech Team (ACT-10):**
1. **Configure Rate Limit Bypass:** Whitelist the De Warren public IP on Vercel or disable Attack Challenge Mode on `staging.join-ecotopia.org` and production for the 18:00–02:00 party window.
2. **Exclude Intake Routes:** Ensure `/citizen`, `/sign-in`, and `/apply` are excluded from aggressive edge challenge rules.
3. **Physical Door Fallback:** Pre-print 120 physical cardstock passports with pre-generated QR codes and numeric serials so intake can proceed 100% offline if the network is interrupted.
:::

### 1. Drop-In Copy for `staging.join-ecotopia.org/terms`

```markdown
### Financial Contribution & Entry Voucher
Participation in Ecotopia requires an advance contribution of **€15.00** (sliding scale €10.00 – €25.00 based on means). This contribution directly offsets venue hiring at De Warren, ceremonial food, communal beverage reserves, and recycled passport cardstock. Advance contributions are processed via the secure event Tikkie link provided upon application approval, or in cash/pin at the garage intake checkpoint. No one is turned away for lack of funds; contact the Organizing Committee for a subsidized carbon grant.

### House Rules, Safety & Game Step-Out Mechanics
1. **Age Requirement:** Ecotopia is strictly an 18+ event. Age verification takes place at the garage threshold.
2. **The Universal Safe-Word ("OZONE"):** If at any point the theatrical roleplay, interrogation, or environment becomes overwhelming, any attendee or performer may speak the word **"OZONE"**. 
   * Upon hearing *"OZONE"*, all nearby participants and state wardens must immediately drop character.
   * Step back, provide space, and ask: *"How can I help you?"*
   * A designated, non-costumed Safety Marshal will escort you to the sanctuary.
3. **The Observer / Free Citizen Option:** Attendees who wish to enjoy the music, visual installations, and drinks without engaging in character interrogation, carbon audits, or ministry labor chores may request an **Observer Wristband** at the door. Wardens and actors are strictly forbidden from conscripting Observer wristband wearers into state chores.
4. **The Sanctuary (Library & Tea Room):** The library on the second floor is designated as a permanent, non-theatrical Safe Zone. No roleplay, propaganda enforcement, or loudspeaker broadcasting is permitted inside this room.
```

### 2. Drop-In Copy for `staging.join-ecotopia.org/privacy`

```markdown
### 1. Data Controller & Organizing Entity
This service is operated by the **Ecotopia Organizing Committee** in partnership with the **De Warren Living Cooperative** (De Warren, Archipel 1, 1095 KJ Amsterdam, The Netherlands). For any data privacy inquiries or access requests, contact the Data Steward at **citizens@join-ecotopia.org**.

### 2. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR Article 6)
We process citizen application data under the following legal bases:
* **Contractual Necessity (Article 6(1)(b)):** Processing your name, email, dietary preferences, and event responses is strictly necessary to assign your event role, administer your physical passport, and grant entry to De Warren.
* **Legitimate Interests (Article 6(1)(f)):** Maintaining event capacity limits, fire safety headcounts, and preventing ticket duplication.

### 3. Absolute Data Retention & Deletion Schedule
All personal data collected through this portal (including names, contact details, quiz responses, and carbon metrics) will be permanently purged from all production databases and automated backups on **19 December 2026** (exactly 21 days following the conclusion of the event). No data is retained, sold, or shared with third parties.
```
